name: Schedule 1
definition: Indicates the unadjusted effective and end date of the schedule.

UnadjustedEffectiveDate.name: Unadjusted Effective Date
UnadjustedEffectiveDate.definition: Indicates the unadjusted date at which obligations under the  derivative transaction come into effect, as included in the confirmation.

UnadjustedEndDate.name: Unadjusted End Date
UnadjustedEndDate.definition: Indicates the end date agreed in the derivative transaction without adjustment.

Price.name: Price
Price.definition: Indicates the price per derivative excluding, where applicable: fees, taxes or commissions.
